q: How does a yarn texturising unit in Silvassa work out carbon per kg?
title: Silvassa texturising unit: carbon per kg
short: Texturising runs on electricity for heaters, godets and winders. Take kWh from the bill, multiply by 0.710 kg CO2, and divide by kg of textured yarn. For a buyer's full figure, add the partially oriented yarn you buy, from the supplier or a database factor, labelled as such.
audience: Polyester texturising and twisting units in Silvassa and Daman

ul: Kg of yarn produced and POY consumed.

p: POY usually carries far more than the texturising step. Ask the POY maker for its figure.

example.title: Worked example
lines: Electricity: 180,000 kWh x 0.710 kg = 127.8 t CO2
About 0.32 kg CO2 per kg, before POY

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
